ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
fr: “None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself.”

ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
fr: “Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity.”

ar: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
fr: “Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.”

intro: The Prophet ﷺ recommended this supplication:
ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
fr: “O Allah, help me in remembering You, in giving You thanks, and worshipping You well.”

ar: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
fr: “The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.”

ar: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
fr: “And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him.”

ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
fr: “He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should either utter good words or better keep silence.”
“Modesty (haya') does not bring anything except good.”

ar: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ
fr: “So by mercy from Allah you were lenient with them.”

ar: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
fr: “Have Taqwa of Allah wherever you are, and follow an evil deed with a good one to wipe it out, and treat the people with good behavior.”

ar: مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرِ النَّاسَ لَا يَشْكُرِ اللَّهَ
fr: “Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah.”

ar: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً
fr: “Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer — We will surely cause him to live a good life.”
“Verily, Allah is Graceful and He loves Grace.”
“Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.”
“The best among you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.”

ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
fr: “So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.”

ar: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
fr: “Facilitate things to people and do not make it hard for them; give good tidings and do not make them run away.”

ar: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
fr: “A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands.”
